subtopic_enhancements.pedagogical_intuition: For 'I-V/P-V curves', active and reactive power flow across high-voltage transmission corridors is bounded by rotor angle delta and line reactance X. Transient stability following fault clearing is evaluated via the Equal Area Criterion.
